Track listing credits the Op.30 performance to four named cellists; full-work extent not established.

PMF identifies four violinists and lists all four movements performed July 15, 2025.

pages.title: A Tear in the Mirror (Derecskei, András)

sourceEvidence.finding: Audio is labelled complete performance with three named cellists; complete score listed; page separately lists composer-made viola arrangement.

pages.title: Allemanda à 3 violes (Du Mont, Henry)
pages.reason: Historical scoring is treble/treble/bass viols, not three independent parts of one instrument.

sourceEvidence.finding: Comments and work materials indicate Tr, Tr, B viol parts.

pages.title: Shadows (Dyson, Peter)
pages.reason: Eight cello parts and complete score are present, but the only listed complete audio is explicitly synthesized MIDI; no human performance found in focused search.

sourceEvidence.finding: Complete score and eight parts listed; recording identified as Sibelius-created audio.

pages.title: Incantations (Déjardin, Renaud)
pages.reason: Complete score and twelve individual cello parts are available; found performance leads refer to saxophone plus quartet or do not establish this exact twelve-cello version.

sourceEvidence.finding: Two movements for twelve cellos; complete score and twelve parts listed.
Ensemble repertoire names an Incantations version for saxophone and cello quartet, which is a different scoring.

pages.title: Suite "Palais Meran" for Cello Quartet (Ellenberger, Kurt)

sourceEvidence.finding: Complete score and parts, five movements, and live premiere recording by Pablo Mahave-Veglia, Jinn Shin, Anthony Arnone, J. T. Alexander.
Grand Valley concert programme lists the five-movement cello quartet suite.

pages.title: Zephyros 2 for Cello Ensemble (Endo, Masao)

sourceEvidence.finding: Listing gives Zephyros II for cello ensemble, approximately 15 minutes; primary source and performance evidence still needed.

Composer estate gives 1987 date, six-minute duration, four cellos or multiples, and full premiere credits.

resume.note: Reviewed all 30 cached pages; checked PAUSE before work and after five-page groups. Focused primary/catalogue and performance searches were made for the four leads and selected ambiguous pages. No canonical edits or pilots.
